Compare annual CPUE indices from the two saved analyses.

**Path:** Catch and effort rows → adjusted and year-only GLMs → annual index comparison.

```{r}
# Read preserved results. Report rendering performs no model fitting.
payload <- jsonlite::fromJSON("report-data.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)
result <- payload$result
record <- payload$record
public <- identical(result$data_kind, "public-wcpfc")
rows_frame <- function(rows) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(rows, function(row) as.data.frame(row, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
}
plot_series <- function(series, field, label) {
  years <- unlist(lapply(series, function(rows) vapply(rows, function(x) x$year, numeric(1))))
  values <- unlist(lapply(series, function(rows) vapply(rows, function(x) x[[field]], numeric(1))))
  colours <- c("#1378a3", "#b56435", "#7357a8", "#328363")
  plot(range(years), range(c(0, values)), type = "n", xlab = "Year", ylab = label)
  for (i in seq_along(series)) {
    lines(vapply(series[[i]], function(x) x$year, numeric(1)),
          vapply(series[[i]], function(x) x[[field]], numeric(1)),
          col = colours[(i - 1) %% length(colours) + 1], lwd = 2)
  }
  legend("topright", names(series), col = colours[seq_along(series)], lty = 1, bty = "n")
}
```
## Methods

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (public) {
  cat("Analysis A fits a quasipoisson GLM with year and cell–quarter effects. ",
      "Analysis B uses year effects only. Both use a log link and ",
      "log(hooks / 1000) as an offset. Predictions at 1000 hooks are averaged ",
      "on the response scale over the same strata with equal weights in every year. ",
      "Each index is divided by its first-year prediction. ",
      "The effort filter belongs to analysis A. Released zero counts are retained.\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("Analysis A fits the synthetic Poisson GLM with year and vessel effects; ",
      "analysis B uses year effects only. Both use log(hooks / 1000) as an offset. ",
      "Predictions at 1000 hooks and the first synthetic vessel are divided by ",
      "the first-year prediction. The effort filter belongs to analysis A.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

<details><summary>Model checks and prediction weights</summary>

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (length(result$analyses)) {
  methods <- lapply(names(result$analyses), function(name) {
    x <- result$analyses[[name]]
    list(analysis = name, formula = x$formula, included = x$sets_used,
         excluded = x$sets_excluded, converged = x$converged,
         score_residual = x$score_residual)
  })
  print(knitr::kable(rows_frame(methods), digits = 7))
}
if (public) {
  x <- result$analyses[[1]]
  cat("\nFixed prediction weights:\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(rows_frame(x$weights), digits = 4))
  cat("\nEstimated dispersion (Pearson sum of squares / residual degrees of freedom):\n\n")
  dispersion <- lapply(names(result$analyses), function(name) {
    x <- result$analyses[[name]]
    list(analysis = name, dispersion = x$dispersion,
         residual_degrees_of_freedom = x$residual_degrees_of_freedom)
  })
  print(knitr::kable(rows_frame(dispersion), digits = 3))
}
```

</details>

## Results

```{r}
endpoints <- lapply(names(result$series), function(name) {
  rows <- result$series[[name]]
  list(analysis = name, first_year = rows[[1]]$year,
       final_year = tail(rows, 1)[[1]]$year,
       final_relative_CPUE = tail(rows, 1)[[1]]$index)
})
plot_series(result$series, "index", "CPUE relative to first year")
```

<details><summary>Annual values and fish per 1,000 hooks</summary>

```{r}
knitr::kable(rows_frame(endpoints), digits = 3)
if (public) {
  standardised <- result$series[[1]]
  nominal <- lapply(standardised, function(row) {
    list(year = row$year, standardised_cpue = row$nominal_cpue)
  })
  plot_series(list("A: fixed strata" = standardised, "Nominal: selected records" = nominal),
              "standardised_cpue", "Albacore per 1000 hooks")
}
```

</details>

## Interpretation

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (public) {
  cat("Differences reflect adjustment for cell–quarter composition and any effort filter. ",
      "The public records aggregate fleet, cell and quarter; vessel identifiers are unavailable. ",
      "This index describes the selected fleet and released strata. It is a simple ",
      "workflow example, with no confidence intervals or official stock assessment advice. ",
      "Absent or suppressed values do not represent zero catch.\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("Differences reflect vessel adjustment and the selected synthetic records. ",
      "This comparison illustrates the workflow and supplies no fisheries advice.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Analysis record

Produced in **`r record$run_id`**. Each input keeps its original producing run.

<details><summary>Inputs and software versions</summary>

```{r}
inputs <- lapply(names(record$inputs), function(key) {
  list(job = key, run = record$inputs[[key]]$run_id,
       output_sha256 = record$inputs[[key]]$checksum)
})
if (length(inputs)) knitr::kable(rows_frame(inputs))
```

New calculations and this Quarto report run inside the declared container. The downloadable bundle includes the actual R job, shared R sources, this QMD, the preserved result JSON, settings and checksums.

```{r}
software <- lapply(names(record$software), function(key) {
  list(component = key, value = as.character(record$software[[key]]))
})
knitr::kable(rows_frame(software))
```

</details>

```{r}
#| results: asis
image <- record$software$container
cat("Calculation image and digest: `", image, "`\n\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(record$software$container_url)) {
  cat("[Container package](", record$software$container_url, ")\n\n", sep = "")
}
if (!is.null(record$source$repository) && !is.null(record$source$commit)) {
  commit_url <- paste0(record$source$repository, "/commit/", record$source$commit)
  cat("[", commit_url, "](", commit_url, ")\n\n", sep = "")
}
cat("<details><summary>Full preserved input record</summary>\n\n```json\n",
    jsonlite::toJSON(record, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE),
    "\n```\n\n</details>\n", sep = "")
```
